description_en: Queries the execution status and runtime information of a file upload task by task ID
description_zh: 通过文件上传任务ID查询对应任务的执行状态及运行信息
name: GetUploadTask

parameters.help_en:
The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation.
<notice>This parameter is required when querying an upload task.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
站点ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取。
<notice>查询上传任务时此参数为必填。></notice>
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The file upload task ID, which is assigned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850466.html operation.
<notice>This parameter is required and must be a valid task ID returned by the UploadFile operation. If this parameter is not provided or the specified ID does not exist, an InvalidParameters (400) error is returned.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
文件上传任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850466.html接口时分配的此字段。
<notice>此参数为必填，必须是通过 UploadFile API 返回的有效任务 ID，未提供或提供不存在的 ID 均返回 InvalidParameters(400)。></notice>
parameters.name: upload_id
